mentions.name: Usefulls (Nomad 23)
mentions.description: Usefulls makes modular furniture/luggage, starting with the Nomad 23: a standard 23 kg checked suitcase that physically converts into a twin-door wardrobe cabinet. With the removable wheels taken off, circular bumps on the base seat into grooves on top of another case, letting multiple units stack into a full-size modular wardrobe.
mentions.problem: Addresses the frustration of buying cheap furniture every time one moves apartments.
